# Nick's Tire & Auto — Cleveland, Ohio

> Cleveland's highest-rated independent auto repair shop and tire dealer. Located at 17625 Euclid Ave, Cleveland (Euclid neighborhood), OH 44112. 4.9 stars with 1,700+ Google reviews. Open 7 days: Monday–Saturday 8 AM – 6 PM, Sunday 9 AM – 4 PM. Phone: (216) 862-0005. First-come-first-served — walk-ins welcome every day.

## About

Nick's Tire & Auto has served Greater Cleveland since 2018. The shop specializes in new and used tires, brake repair, engine diagnostics, Ohio E-Check emissions testing, oil changes, and general auto repair. Walk-ins are welcome every day. The shop offers $0-down payment programs through Acima, Snap Finance, Koalafi, and American First Finance with no traditional credit check required.

## Services

- [Tires](https://nickstire.org/tires): New tires from all major brands plus quality-inspected used tires from $25 (select 12-inch sizes; most sizes $40-80 installed). Free $266 installation package on every set (mount, balance, valve stems, TPMS reset, alignment check, disposal).
- [Tire Repair](https://nickstire.org/tire-repair-cleveland): Flat tire repair $15–25. Plug-and-patch. Most repairs done in 15 minutes.
- [Brakes](https://nickstire.org/brakes): Pads, rotors, calipers, brake lines, ABS diagnostics. Starting at $89. Same-day service available.
- [Diagnostics](https://nickstire.org/diagnostics): Check engine light, OBD-II code reading, advanced computer diagnostics. Free 5-minute scan, written estimate before any work.
- [Wheel Alignment](https://nickstire.org/wheel-alignment-cleveland): Hunter alignment rack. From $89. Free alignment check on every new tire install.
- [Oil Change](https://nickstire.org/oil-change): Conventional from $39.99, full synthetic from $69.99. Free 27-point inspection included.
- [Ohio E-Check / Emissions](https://nickstire.org/emissions): Certified E-Check station. Emissions diagnostics and repair — oxygen sensors, EVAP systems, catalytic converters. Usually done in 20–30 minutes.
- [AC & Heating Repair](https://nickstire.org/ac-repair): Recharge from $49. Compressor and evaporator repair available.
- [Transmission](https://nickstire.org/transmission): Diagnostics, fluid service, and repair for automatic and manual transmissions.
- [Electrical](https://nickstire.org/electrical): Battery testing (free), alternator, starter motor replacement.
- [Exhaust & Muffler](https://nickstire.org/exhaust): Muffler, catalytic converter, exhaust manifold repair.
- [General Repair](https://nickstire.org/general-repair): Engine repair, cooling systems, belts, hoses, water pumps, head gaskets, suspension and steering (struts, shocks, control arms, ball joints).
- [Fleet Service](https://nickstire.org/fleet): Commercial fleet maintenance with priority scheduling.

## Payment Programs

Four no-credit-check providers compete on the spot:

1. **Acima** — Lease-to-own up to $5,000. 90-day same-as-cash. Uses bank history, not credit score.
2. **Snap Finance** — Up to $5,000. 100-day early payoff. 60-second application.
3. **Koalafi** — Up to $7,500 (highest amount). Flexible terms. Early buyout discounts.
4. **American First Finance** — Up to $5,000. 90-day same-as-cash. No early payment penalties.

[Compare all four](https://nickstire.org/financing): Side-by-side comparison plus a single application that submits to all providers.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need an appointment?**
No. Walk-ins welcome 7 days a week. For larger repairs you can [schedule a drop-off](https://nickstire.org/booking) online.

**Do you sell used tires?**
Yes. Quality-inspected used tires from $25 (select 12-inch sizes; most sizes $40-80 installed). Every tire checked for tread depth, sidewall condition, and safety before sale.

**How much does a flat tire repair cost?**
$15–25. Plug-and-patch. Most repairs done in about 15 minutes.

**Do you offer financing?**
Yes — four providers, no traditional credit check: Acima, Snap Finance, Koalafi, American First Finance. Apply online or at the counter in minutes. [See options](https://nickstire.org/financing).

**What are your hours?**
Monday–Saturday 8 AM – 6 PM, Sunday 9 AM – 4 PM. Open 7 days, every day, year-round.

**Do you do Ohio E-Check?**
Yes — certified Ohio E-Check emissions testing station. Walk-ins welcome, usually done in 20–30 minutes. [Emissions repair details](https://nickstire.org/emissions).
